packet.title: EXI schema-informed grammars
packet.summary: Builds the schema-informed grammars of EXI 1.0, section 8.5, from a compiled schema, decodes and encodes with them, strict and not, with typed values and the datatypeRepresentationMap.

body.p: After 8.5. EXI 1.0, sections 7.1 (built-in datatypes by schema type), 7.4 (datatypeRepresentationMap) and 8.5 (schema-informed document, fragment, element fragment and type grammars, normalization, event codes, the undeclared productions of non-strict grammars); the components of src/schema_internal.h.

item.p: Mechanism: src/exi_schema_grammar.c, the proto-grammars of every particle, term and attribute use, normalized and numbered, built once per schema and kept with it; xsi:type and xsi:nil; the built-in types only grammars of the empty schemaId.
Done when: every decode and encode check of the schema and xsd-types-only sets passes but header and canonical (8.10, 8.11), and the strict cases the oracle refused are refused.
